key_insight: An inline optical roll-to-roll imaging setup can rapidly and robustly measure multiple thin-film layer thicknesses and birefringence in one pass.
engineering_relevance: This enables real-time quality control and process optimization for organic photovoltaic manufacturing, especially for transparent or semi-transparent coatings on free films or substrates.
method: Optical in-line inspection during roll-to-roll deposition
Applicable to PEDOT and ZnO thin-film layers and birefringence characterization
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-concept demonstration with PEDOT and ZnO materials and a validated measurement range spanning 0.3 to 110 micrometers.
watch_item: Performance may depend on optical transparency and calibration quality, so highly absorbing or strongly scattering films could be more challenging to characterize reliably.
paper_title: Resolving multiple layer thicknesses and birefringence in thin films with an optical in-line Roll-to-Roll characterization setup
